patch:
Index: docker-compose.yml
===================================================================
--- docker-compose.yml	
+++ docker-compose.yml	
@@ -1,40 +1,40 @@
 services:
   # Expo Mobile App (Development)
   mobile-app:
-    image:expo/expo:latest
+    build: .
     container_name: cargo-mobile-app
     ports:
       - "8081:8081"  # Expo Dev Server
       - "19000:19000"  # Expo REPL
       - "19001:19001"  # Expo Web
     environment:
       - NODE_ENV=development
       - EXPO_DEV=true
       - API_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8080/api/v1
     volumes:
       - .:/app
       - /app/node_modules
     working_dir: /app
     command: ["npx", "expo", "start", "--dev-client", "--clear"]
 
   # Backend API (Cargo) - existing in TehranSaadat
   backend:
     image: php:8.2-apache
     container_name: cargo-backend
     working_dir: /var/www/html
     volumes:
       - ../:/var/www/html
     environment:
       - APACHE_DOCUMENT_ROOT=/var/www/html
       - DB_HOST=irex-postgres
       - DB_NAME=cargodb
       - DB_USER=root
       - DB_PASSWORD=root
     expose:
       - "8080"
     networks:
       - default
 
 networks:
   default:
     driver: bridge
